TABLES.about: A course, such as the six-week And Breathe programme. A cohort can run a tweaked copy, linked back to the original.
TABLES.access: Everyone signed in can read published programmes. Only admins can create or edit them.

TABLES.about: Named stretches of a programme, such as the carbon dioxide tolerance block in weeks 3 to 4.
TABLES.access: Readable when the programme is published. Admins edit.

TABLES.about: The guided session steps for each week: pulse, base test, holds and recoveries. Lives in the database so courses can change week to week.
TABLES.access: Readable when the programme is published. Admins edit.

TABLES.about: A group running a programme together, such as the October cohort.
TABLES.access: Members and the coach of the cohort can read it. Admins create and edit.

TABLES.about: Who is in which cohort, as a member or coach, and between which dates. The dates decide which of a member's data shows in which cohort.
TABLES.access: Members see only their own row. Coaches see their whole roster. Members can switch sharing to the group on or off and leave. Admins add and remove people.

TABLES.about: A member's run through a programme. Week number comes from the start date, so swapping cohorts never resets progress. Members can be in several programmes at once.
TABLES.access: Members manage their own. Their coach and admins can read them.

TABLES.about: One per person, created automatically the first time they sign in with Google. Deleting a person removes everything they own.
TABLES.access: You can read your own profile, and the name and photo of people currently in your cohorts. You can edit your name, photo and time zone, but never your own role.

TABLES.about: Notification and session audio choices from the Settings screen. Created with defaults on sign-up.
Reminder time and on or off for morning, noon and evening. Seeded with 7:00, 12:30 and 20:30.
One breathwork session: a slot on a date, within an enrolment. Base score is worked out by the database from the holds, so it is quick to read.
TABLES.access: Members manage their own. Their coach can read sessions dated while the member was in the coach's cohort. Admins read all.

TABLES.about: Each breath hold in a session, in seconds. Saving a hold refreshes the session's base score.
TABLES.access: Follows the session: the member, their coach within dates, and admins.

TABLES.about: How are you arriving: mood and pulse for each session. Sleep is only asked on the first check-in of the day.
TABLES.access: Members manage their own. Their coach can read them within dates. Cohort mates only ever see the mood, through the group feed.

TABLES.about: The Log a workout screen. Fields that only apply to some workout types are simply left empty.
TABLES.access: Members manage their own. Their coach can read them within dates.

TABLES.about: Posts in a cohort's feed. Members write their own, and finishing a session adds a check-in post automatically when sharing to the group is on.
TABLES.access: Current members of the cohort read and post. Authors edit their own. Authors, the coach and admins can delete.

TABLES.about: Comments underneath a post, like Tom's reply to Mia.
TABLES.access: Current cohort members read and comment. Authors delete their own.

TABLES.about: A cheer (like) on a post. One per person per post.
TABLES.access: Current cohort members read and cheer. Members remove their own cheer.

TABLES.about: A read-only view that gives the Group screen everything in one request: post, author name and photo, slot, mood, cheer count and comment count. It never exposes pulse, holds or notes.
